topic: Dashboard visualization tool comparison and setup
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on troubleshooting a Superset dashboard that was returning 502 errors, initially attributed to memory issues. After increasing the allocated memory (to 6GB, then reduced to 4GB), the dashboard became functional and displayed data for the last year with weekly granularity.

A discussion ensued regarding the optimal visualization tool. While Superset was used for initial testing, concerns were raised about its limited interactivity (e.g., poor drill-down functionality) and tendency to generate non-optimal queries. Grafana was proposed as a superior alternative because it can create charts directly from SQL queries and has built-in options to display zero values when data is absent.

Ultimately, the participants agreed to test Grafana further, although they also acknowledged that both tools have limitations in advanced features like interactive filtering.
decisions: The Superset dashboard was successfully configured to display weekly aggregated data for the last year.
Grafana will be tested as a primary visualization tool due to its ability to handle SQL queries and manage zero values.
action_items: Test Grafana's capabilities against the current Superset setup.
